120.news_title: Pinball Arcade Generic Version Software Installation Walkthrough
120.long_description: Arcooda's Pinball Arcade Generic Software provides a package with 76 past pinball titles, playable on virtually any cabinet, that way you can build your own and just install the Arcooda software. Before purchasing and installing the Generic Cabinet Arcooda Pinball Arcade Software, please ensure that your system requirements meet Arcooda Pinball Arcade’s minimum requirements: • Windows 7 or higher. • Windows 10 (for Kinect Version software) • 9.3GB Storage. Step 1: To begin your installation of Arcooda Pinball Arcade on your Windows PC, insert the silver Arcooda installation drive into your PC.
